notes.key_messages:
• Prepare all the topics on the syllabus.
• Show clear working.
• Write clearly and do not overwrite one solution with another. This results in an illegible script once
• Check your algebra and arithmetic carefully.
• If a question asks you to obtain a given answer, then take particular care to show full working.
• If a question asks for an exact answer, then decimal working is not appropriate.
notes.general_comments:
The response to this paper was varied. Some candidates showed a good knowledge of all topics on the
specification and gave good answers to all ten questions. However, a large proportion of candidates offered
no response at all to the last two questions (Vectors and Complex Numbers) which accounted for 23 of the
75 marks unavailable.
